headline: Lincoln Financial Reports 2025 Third Quarter Results
rationale: Mixed quarter: GAAP net income swung to $2.12 per diluted share from a $(3.29) loss largely on non-economic market-risk-benefit and embedded-derivative items, while non-GAAP adjusted operating income per diluted share was flat at $2.04 vs $2.06, despite record annuity balances and 32% annuity sales growth.

headline: Liquidia Corporation Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results and Provides Business Update
rationale: Q4 2025 revenue rose to $92.0M from $2.9M on YUTREPIA launch sales of $90.1M and GAAP net income was $14.6M vs a $38.5M net loss a year earlier, a second consecutive profitable quarter with cash up to $190.7M.

headline: Life Time Reports Second Quarter 2024 Financial Results
rationale: Q2 2024 revenue grew 18.9% to $667.8M, GAAP net income rose to $52.8M from $17.0M, adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) rose 27.6%, and full-year 2024 revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance was raised.

headline: Life Time announces preliminary Q3 2024 results and launches refinancing of 2026 notes
rationale: Preliminary Q3 2024 revenue up 18.5% to $693.2M, GAAP net income up 422.5% to $41.4M and adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) up 26.1%, with net debt leverage down to 2.4x as the company launched a $1B term loan refinancing of its 2026 notes.

headline: Lyft Reports Record Q2 2025 Financial Results
rationale: Record Q2 2025 with gross bookings up 12% to $4.5B, GAAP net income of $40.3M vs $5.0M a year earlier and adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) up 26%, plus Q3 guidance for 13-17% gross bookings growth and the close of the FreeNow acquisition.

headline: Lyft and Waymo Launch Partnership to Expand Autonomous Mobility to Nashville
rationale: New multi-year partnership under which Lyft's Flexdrive will manage Waymo's Nashville autonomous fleet and Waymo vehicles will be dispatched on Lyft's network in 2026, a major partnership.

headline: Lyft Reports Record Q3 2025 Financial Results
rationale: Record Q3 2025 gross bookings up 16% to $4.8B, GAAP net income of $46.1M vs a $(12.4)M loss a year earlier and adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) up 29%, with Q4 gross bookings guided up 17-20%.

headline: Moelis & Company Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Financial Results; Increases Quarterly Dividend 8% to $0.65 Per Share
rationale: Q4 2024 revenues rose 104% year over year to $438.7M with GAAP net income of $99.8M ($1.15 diluted EPS), full-year revenues up about 40%, and the quarterly dividend raised 8%.

headline: Moog Inc. Reports Outstanding Second Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full-Year Guidance
rationale: Q2 FY2026 sales rose 13% to $1.05B, GAAP diluted EPS rose 49% to $2.55 (adjusted non-GAAP EPS up 40% to $2.64), 12-month backlog hit a record $3.3B, and full-year adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $10.60 from $10.20.

headline: Morningstar, Inc. Reports First-Quarter 2024 Financial Results
rationale: Q1 2024 revenue grew 13.2% to $542.8M, GAAP operating income rose to $92.6M from $24.5M and GAAP diluted EPS was $1.49 vs $(0.18) a year earlier, with free cash flow turning positive.

headline: Morningstar, Inc. Reports Second-Quarter 2024 Financial Results
rationale: Q2 2024 revenue grew 13.3% to $571.9M, GAAP operating income rose 160.2% to $108.5M and GAAP diluted EPS rose 90.5% to $1.60, led by 43.2% growth at Morningstar Credit.

headline: Microsoft Cloud and AI strength fuels fourth quarter results
rationale: FY25 Q4 revenue rose 18% to $76.4B and GAAP net income and diluted EPS ($3.65) each rose 24%, with Azure surpassing $75B in annual revenue (up 34%) and commercial bookings up 30%.

headline: The next chapter of the Microsoft-OpenAI partnership
rationale: New definitive agreement gives Microsoft a roughly 27% stake in the recapitalized OpenAI Group PBC valued at about $135B, extends its IP rights through 2032, and includes an incremental $250B OpenAI commitment to purchase Azure services.

headline: Microsoft Cloud and AI strength fuels first quarter results (FY26 Q1)
rationale: FY26 Q1 revenue rose 18% to $77.7B, GAAP operating income rose 24% to $38.0B and GAAP net income rose 12% to $27.7B, with Azure and other cloud services revenue up 40%.

headline: NCR Atleos Corporation Reports Strong First Quarter 2026 Results with 7% Revenue Growth
rationale: Mixed Q1 2026: revenue rose 7% and GAAP net income rose 57% to $22M ($0.29 diluted EPS), but non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA was flat, adjusted diluted EPS rose only 2%, gross margin fell, and no outlook was given due to the pending Brink's acquisition.

headline: Shareholders Overwhelmingly Vote to Approve Brink's Acquisition of NCR Atleos
rationale: Procedural milestone for the previously announced Brink's acquisition: both shareholder bases approved the deal and HSR clearance was received, with closing expected by end of Q1 2027.

headline: NCR Atleos Corporation Reports Strong Second Quarter Results
rationale: Q2 2026 GAAP net income rose 67% to $65M (diluted EPS up 65% to $0.86) and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA rose about 25% to $254M on gross margin expansion to 28.0%, despite flat revenue.

headline: Neurocrine Biosciences Reports Third Quarter 2025 Financial Results
rationale: Q3 2025 total revenue rose 28% to $794.9M on record INGREZZA demand and $98M of CRENESSITY launch sales, with GAAP diluted EPS up 65% to $2.04 (non-GAAP diluted EPS up 20% to $2.17) and INGREZZA guidance reaffirmed.

headline: Enpro Reports Strong First Quarter 2025 Results
rationale: Q1 2025 sales rose 6.1% to $273.2M and GAAP net income nearly doubled to $24.5M ($1.15 GAAP diluted EPS vs $0.59), with non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA up 16.1% and full-year guidance maintained.

headline: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2026
rationale: Record Q4 FY26 revenue of $68.1B (up 73% YoY, Data Center up 75%) with GAAP diluted EPS of $1.76 and non-GAAP $1.62, and Q1 FY27 revenue outlook of $78.0B well above the quarter just reported.

headline: Meta Builds AI Infrastructure With NVIDIA
rationale: Multiyear, multigenerational strategic partnership under which Meta will deploy NVIDIA Grace CPUs, millions of Blackwell and Rubin GPUs and Spectrum-X Ethernet switching across its hyperscale data centers.

headline: Nvidia buying AI chip startup Groq's assets for about $20 billion in its largest deal on record
rationale: Nvidia agreed to a roughly $20B non-exclusive license of Groq's AI inference technology and to hire Groq's founder, president and other team members, a growth-directed deal to strengthen its inference offering.

headline: NVIDIA Announces Financial Results for Second Quarter Fiscal 2027
rationale: Q2 FY27 revenue of $96.2B rose 106% YoY (Data Center $89.0B, up 117%) with GAAP diluted EPS of $2.46 and non-GAAP $2.22, and management said Vera Rubin is ramping into full production with demand accelerating.

headline: NVIDIA Partners With Apollo, BlackRock, Blackstone, Brookfield, Goldman Sachs and KKR to Establish AI Compute Infrastructure Financing Platforms to Mobilize Over $500 Billion of Third-Party Capital
rationale: Major partnership with six large asset managers to create financing platforms targeting over $500B of third-party capital for AI infrastructure built on NVIDIA compute.

headline: OGE Energy Corp. reports 2024 results and outlook for 2025
rationale: 2024 GAAP net income rose to $441.5M from $416.8M ($2.19 vs $2.07 GAAP diluted EPS) on strong load growth, with 2025 EPS guidance midpoint of $2.27 and a 5-7% annual EPS growth target.

headline: Lawmakers Appeal OG&E rate increase; Ask OK Supreme Court to Rule on Hiett's Failure to Disqualify and OCC's One-Page Audits
rationale: Three state lawmakers filed an Oklahoma Supreme Court appeal challenging the Corporation Commission's approval of OG&E's roughly $127M rate increase and the audits of its Winter Storm Uri bonds, creating litigation risk to the rate order.

headline: OPENLANE, Inc. Reports First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
rationale: Q1 2026 revenue rose 15% to $528M and GAAP net income rose 33% to $48.9M, and the company raised full-year 2026 guidance for GAAP net income ($147-164M from $130-147M), diluted EPS and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA.

headline: OPENLANE, Inc. Reports 2025 Financial Results
rationale: Q4 2025 revenue rose 9% to $494M and GAAP income from continuing operations rose 14% to $60M, with full-year GAAP income from continuing operations up 62% to $178M and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA up 13%.

headline: Everpure Announces Second Quarter Fiscal 2027 Financial Results
rationale: Q2 FY27 revenue rose 38% to $1.2B and GAAP net income rose to $74.1M from $47.1M, and FY27 guidance was raised significantly (revenue to $5.03-5.07B from $4.41-4.51B; non-GAAP operating income to $940-960M).

headline: Everpure Announces Data Stream to Expand AI-Ready Data Offerings
rationale: Routine product launch of Everpure Data Stream, built on NVIDIA's AI Data Platform reference design, with no disclosed financial terms or customer commitments.

headline: PBF Energy Announces First Quarter 2026 Results, Declares Dividend of $0.275 per Share and Update on Restart of Martinez Refinery
rationale: Q1 2026 GAAP net income attributable to PBF of $198.3M ($1.65 per share) versus a large prior-year loss, with GAAP income from operations of $299.6M vs a $511.2M loss and the Martinez refinery restart nearing full rates.

headline: PBF Energy Announces Pricing of $500 Million of Senior Notes due 2034
rationale: Routine refinancing: $500M of 7.25% senior notes due 2034 priced to help redeem $801.6M of 6.00% notes due 2028.

headline: Pega GenAI Powers Accelerated Q1 2025 Results
rationale: Q1 2025 revenue rose 44% to $475.6M and GAAP net income swung to $85.4M ($0.91 GAAP diluted EPS) from a $12.1M loss, with ACV up 13%, Pega Cloud ACV up 23% and record free cash flow.

headline: Pega's AI Strategy Powers Continued Acceleration in Q2 2025
rationale: Q2 2025 revenue rose 9% to $384.5M and GAAP net income rose to $30.1M from $6.6M, with ACV up 16% and Pega Cloud ACV up 28% YoY.

headline: Piper Sandler Companies Reports Third Quarter 2025 Results; Declares Quarterly Dividend of $0.70 Per Share
rationale: Q3 2025 net revenues rose 33% YoY to $479M and GAAP net income rose 73% to $60.3M ($3.38 vs $1.96 GAAP diluted EPS).

headline: Piper Sandler Announces Acquisition to Strengthen Presence in the Middle East
rationale: Growth-directed acquisition of Abu Dhabi-based merchant bank MENA Growth Partners to serve as the firm's investment banking hub in the GCC region.

headline: Planet Fitness, Inc. Announces First Quarter 2025 Results
rationale: Q1 2025 revenue rose 11.5% to $276.7M with system-wide same club sales up 6.1%, and GAAP net income attributable to Planet Fitness rose to $41.9M ($0.50 GAAP diluted EPS vs $0.39).

headline: PTC Therapeutics Provides Corporate Update and Reports First Quarter 2025 Financial Results
rationale: GAAP net income swung to $866.6M from a $91.6M net loss, driven by the $986.2M Novartis PTC518 license revenue, and the company narrowed its 2025 revenue guidance to $650-800M on stronger-than-expected Q1, though core net product revenue fell to $153.4M from $177.6M.

headline: PTC Therapeutics Announces FDA Approval of Sephience (sepiapterin) for Children and Adults Living with PKU
rationale: FDA approved Sephience for sepiapterin-responsive PKU in patients one month and older with a broad label, a major regulatory approval following recent EU authorization.

headline: Ralliant Spotlights Award of $27.3M Investment from the Defense Production Act to Scale Production at its PacSci EMC Operating Company
rationale: A $27.3M Defense Production Act award funds production capacity expansion at the PacSci EMC unit, a government-backed capacity expansion.

headline: Ralliant Reports Second Quarter 2026 Results and Raises Full Year Guidance
rationale: Revenue rose 13% YoY to $568M (organic +13%), GAAP net earnings were $57M ($0.51 diluted EPS) with non-GAAP adjusted EPS of $0.68, results exceeded the high end of guidance and full-year 2026 guidance was raised.

headline: RBC Bearings Incorporated Announces Fiscal Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results
rationale: Fiscal Q4 net sales rose 5.8% with Aerospace/Defense up 10.6%, non-GAAP adjusted diluted EPS rose to $2.83 from $2.47, GAAP net income margin improved to 16.6% from 13.5%, and backlog grew to $940.7M.

headline: RBC Bearings Announces Agreement to Acquire VACCO Industries from ESCO Technologies
rationale: Growth-directed acquisition of VACCO, a maker of valves and precision components for space and naval defense, expanding the Aerospace & Defense segment.

headline: RBC Bearings Incorporated Announces Fiscal First Quarter 2026 Results
rationale: Fiscal Q1 net sales rose 7.3% to $436.0M, GAAP net income margin rose to 15.7% from 13.7%, free cash flow rose to $104.3M, and Q2 sales were guided to 11.8%-14.4% YoY growth.

headline: Royal Caribbean Group Reports First Quarter Results and Increases Full Year Guidance
rationale: Q1 GAAP EPS of $2.70 and non-GAAP adjusted EPS of $2.71 beat company guidance, revenue rose 11% YoY, and full-year adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $14.55-$15.55.

headline: Royal Caribbean Group Reports Second Quarter Results and Increases Full Year Guidance
rationale: Q2 GAAP EPS of $4.41 and non-GAAP adjusted EPS of $4.38 beat guidance on revenue of $4.5B and adjusted EBITDA of $1.9B, and full-year adjusted EPS guidance was raised to $15.41-$15.55.

headline: Reddit Announces Third Quarter 2025 Results
rationale: Revenue rose 68% YoY to $584.9M, GAAP net income rose to $162.7M from $29.9M, non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA rose to $236.0M from $94.1M, and DAUq grew 19%.

headline: Remitly Reports Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2024 Results Above Outlook
rationale: Q4 revenue rose 33% to $351.9M above outlook with non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA of $43.7M and a narrow GAAP net loss of $5.7M, and 2025 guidance called for 25-26% revenue growth and positive full-year GAAP net income.

headline: Remitly Reports First Quarter 2025 Results Above Outlook and Raises Full Year 2025 Outlook
rationale: Q1 revenue rose 34% and send volume 41%, GAAP net income turned positive at $11.4M with non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA of $58.4M, and full-year 2025 revenue and adjusted EBITDA outlook was raised.

headline: Construction Partners, Inc. Acquires Platform Company in Tennessee
rationale: Growth-directed $96.5M acquisition of PRI of East Tennessee and Pavement Restorations establishes a new platform company and market entry in Tennessee.

headline: Construction Partners, Inc. Announces Fiscal 2025 Second Quarter Results
rationale: Fiscal Q2 revenue rose 54% YoY, GAAP net income was $4.2M ($0.08 EPS), non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA rose 135%, backlog hit a record $2.84B, and FY25 outlook was raised.

headline: Amazon Ads and Roku Announce Partnership Creating the Largest Authenticated CTV Footprint
rationale: Major partnership giving Amazon DSP advertisers exclusive authenticated access to Roku's CTV footprint, reaching an estimated 80M U.S. CTV households.

headline: Roku Releases Second Quarter 2025 Financial Results
rationale: Platform revenue grew 18% YoY above outlook and full-year 2025 platform revenue and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA outlook was raised to $4.075B and $375M, alongside a new $400M buyback.

headline: Roku Releases Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Financial Results
rationale: Q4 revenue rose 16% to $1.395B, GAAP net income was $80.5M versus a $35.5M net loss a year earlier, and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA rose 119% to $169.4M.

headline: Roku Releases First Quarter 2026 Financial Results
rationale: Q1 revenue rose 22% to $1.25B with platform revenue up 28%, GAAP net income was $86M, and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA rose 165% to $148M.

headline: Fox Corporation and Roku announce definitive merger agreement
rationale: Roku signed a board-approved definitive agreement to be acquired by Fox for $96.00 in cash plus 0.9693 Fox Class A shares per Roku share, with holders of about 55% of voting power agreeing to support it.

headline: Red Rock Resorts Announces Fourth Quarter and Full Year 2025 Results
rationale: Mixed quarter: net revenue rose 3.2% and non-GAAP adjusted EBITDA rose 5.4% to $213.3M, but GAAP net income fell 3.5% to $84.6M, alongside a $1.00 special dividend.

headline: Sonic Automotive Reports First Quarter 2025 Financial Results
rationale: Record Q1 revenue of $3.7B (+8% YoY) with GAAP net income up 68% to $70.6M and GAAP diluted EPS up 70% to $2.04 (non-GAAP adjusted EPS $1.48, +9%), a clear YoY beat even though some 2025 guidance items were updated or withdrawn over tariff uncertainty.

headline: Sanmina Reports Third Quarter Fiscal 2026 Financial Results
rationale: Revenue rose 69% YoY to $3.46B, GAAP diluted EPS rose to $2.12 from $1.26 and non-GAAP diluted EPS to $3.31 from $1.53, and the company raised full-year FY2026 non-GAAP diluted EPS guidance to $11.90-$12.20.

headline: Sabra Reports First Quarter 2024 Results; Reiterates 2024 Guidance
rationale: GAAP net income per diluted share swung to $0.11 from a $(0.04) loss a year earlier, non-GAAP normalized FFO per share edged up to $0.34 from $0.33, skilled nursing rent coverage improved, and 2024 guidance was reiterated.

headline: Sprouts Farmers Market, Inc. Reports First Quarter 2025 Results
rationale: Net sales rose 19% with 11.7% comparable store sales growth, GAAP net income rose 58% to $180.0M and GAAP diluted EPS to $1.81 from $1.12, and the company raised its full-year 2025 outlook (diluted EPS $4.94-$5.10).

headline: ScottsMiracle-Gro Reports Fiscal 2024 Third Quarter Results
rationale: Q3 net sales rose 7% to $1.2B, GAAP net income rose to $132.1M from $43.7M (GAAP diluted EPS $2.28 vs $0.77), and non-GAAP fiscal 2024 guidance was reaffirmed apart from a lower Hawthorne sales outlook.

headline: TD SYNNEX Reports Record Fiscal 2026 Second Quarter Results
rationale: Record Q2 revenue of $19.6B (+31% YoY) came in above the high end of the outlook, GAAP diluted EPS was $4.15 and non-GAAP diluted EPS rose 62.2% YoY to $4.85, and the quarterly dividend was raised 9%.

headline: SPX Technologies to Acquire Crawford United
rationale: Definitive agreement for a roughly $300M cash acquisition of Crawford United, a growth-directed deal expanding SPX's HVAC custom air-handling and coil portfolio.

headline: SPX Technologies Announces Acquisition of Thermolec
rationale: Completed a growth-directed acquisition of Montreal-based electric duct-heating maker Thermolec for about US$140M (about US$35M annual revenue), adding to the HVAC Electric Heat business.

headline: SPX Reports Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2025 Results
rationale: Q4 revenue rose 19.4%, GAAP income from continuing operations rose 38.4% (GAAP EPS $1.54, +29.4%; non-GAAP adjusted EPS $1.88, +24.5%), and 2026 guidance calls for about 13% revenue growth and about 15% adjusted EPS growth at the midpoint.

headline: Spire to acquire Tennessee Piedmont Natural Gas business from Duke Energy
rationale: Agreement to buy Duke Energy's Tennessee Piedmont gas utility (200,000+ Nashville-area customers) for $2.48B, which the company expects to be accretive to adjusted EPS and supportive of its 5-7% growth target; it is financed with a committed bridge and a mix of debt, equity and hybrids.

headline: Spire reports FY25 third quarter results
rationale: Fiscal Q3 GAAP net income was $20.9M ($0.29 per diluted share) versus a $12.6M loss ($(0.28)) a year earlier, fiscal 2025 adjusted EPS guidance of $4.40-$4.60 was reaffirmed, and a unanimous stipulation was filed in the Missouri rate case.

headline: Spire Reports Fiscal 2025 Results
rationale: Fiscal 2025 GAAP diluted EPS rose to $4.37 from $4.19 and non-GAAP adjusted EPS rose 7.5% to $4.44; the dividend was raised 5.1%, fiscal 2026 adjusted EPS guidance was set at $5.25-$5.45 and the 10-year capex target was raised to $11.2B.

headline: Sterling Reports Record Second Quarter 2024 Results and Raises Full Year Guidance
rationale: Revenue rose 12% to $582.8M and GAAP net income rose 31% to $51.9M ($1.67 per diluted share), with E-Infrastructure data center revenue more than doubling, and full-year guidance was raised.

headline: Sterling Reports Record Third Quarter 2024 Results and Raises Full Year Profitability Guidance
rationale: Q3 revenue rose 6% to $593.7M, GAAP net income and GAAP diluted EPS both rose 56% (EPS $1.97), and full-year 2024 profitability guidance was raised to $5.85-$6.00 GAAP diluted EPS.

headline: Tutor Perini Reports Second Quarter 2024 Results
rationale: Revenue rose 10% to $1.1B and GAAP net income attributable swung to $0.8M ($0.02 diluted EPS) from a $37.5M loss ($(0.72)) a year earlier despite settlement and stock-compensation charges; backlog was $10.4B including a $1.3B Connecticut bridge award, and 2024 EPS guidance of $0.85-$1.10 was affirmed.

headline: Trinity Industries, Inc. Announces Second Quarter 2024 Results
rationale: Q2 2024 GAAP diluted EPS from continuing operations rose to $0.67 from $0.23 on 16% revenue growth, and the company raised full-year 2024 EPS guidance to $1.55-$1.75.

headline: TrustCo Reports First Quarter 2026 Net Income of $16.3 Million; Notes Loan Portfolio Repricing
rationale: Q1 2026 GAAP net income rose 14.1% YoY to $16.3 million with net interest income up 10.7% and net interest margin expanding to 2.84% from 2.64%.

headline: Twilio Announces First Quarter 2025 Results
rationale: Q1 2025 revenue grew 12% YoY to $1.17 billion, GAAP income from operations improved $67 million YoY to $23 million, and the company raised full-year organic growth and non-GAAP income from operations guidance.

headline: Twilio Announces Third Quarter 2025 Results
rationale: Q3 2025 revenue rose 15% YoY to $1.3 billion, GAAP net income swung to $37.2 million ($0.23 diluted EPS) from a loss, full-year revenue and non-GAAP income from operations guidance were raised, and a deal to acquire Stytch was announced.

headline: Twilio Announces Second Quarter 2026 Results
rationale: Q2 2026 revenue rose 22% YoY to $1.50 billion, non-GAAP diluted EPS rose to $1.47 from $1.19 (GAAP EPS inflated by a one-time tax benefit), and full-year 2026 revenue and non-GAAP income from operations guidance were raised.

headline: United Fire Group, Inc. reports second quarter 2025 results
rationale: Q2 2025 GAAP net income improved $25.7 million YoY to $22.9 million ($0.87 diluted EPS), with net written premium up 14% and the combined ratio improving 9.2 points to 96.4%.

headline: United Fire Group, Inc. reports third quarter 2025 results
rationale: Q3 2025 GAAP net income rose $19.4 million YoY to $39.2 million ($1.49 diluted EPS), with the combined ratio improving 6.3 points to 91.9% and book value per share up $4.42 year-to-date.

headline: UMB Financial Corporation Reports First Quarter 2026 Results
rationale: Q1 2026 GAAP net income available to common shareholders rose 222.3% YoY to $255.6 million ($3.35 diluted EPS) and non-GAAP net operating income rose 53.8%, on 31.1% revenue growth.

headline: URBN Reports Record Q2 Sales and Income
rationale: Q2 FY2026 GAAP net income rose to a record $143.9 million ($1.58 diluted EPS) from $117.5 million ($1.24) on 11.3% net sales growth to a record $1.50 billion.

headline: US Foods Reports Third Quarter Fiscal Year 2025 Earnings
rationale: Q3 2025 GAAP diluted EPS rose 9.8% to $0.67 and non-GAAP adjusted diluted EPS rose 25.9% to $1.07, with adjusted EBITDA up 11% and an agreement to acquire distributor Shetakis.

headline: US Foods Reaffirms Fiscal Year 2025 Guidance
rationale: Routine reaffirmation of previously issued fiscal 2025 guidance ahead of an ICR Conference fireside chat, with no change to targets.

headline: US Foods Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2025 Earnings
rationale: Q4 2025 GAAP net income rose to $184 million ($0.82 diluted EPS) from $66 million ($0.28), non-GAAP adjusted diluted EPS rose 23.8%, and fiscal 2026 guidance calls for 18-24% adjusted diluted EPS growth.

headline: Victory Capital Announces New $200 Million Share Repurchase Program
rationale: Board authorized a new $200 million buyback through 2026 after completing the prior $100 million program, a routine capital-return action.

headline: Victory Capital Reports Record Fourth-Quarter and Full-Year Earnings Per Share
rationale: Q4 2024 GAAP net income rose 39.4% YoY to $76.9 million ($1.17 diluted EPS) on 12.9% revenue growth, with a 7% dividend increase and the Amundi US acquisition on track, despite $1.7 billion of long-term net outflows.

headline: VIAVI Announces Fiscal Fourth Quarter and Fiscal Year 2025 Results
rationale: Fiscal Q4 2025 net revenue rose 15.3% YoY to $290.5M at the high end of guidance, GAAP diluted EPS swung to $0.04 from -$0.10 and non-GAAP diluted EPS rose 62.5% to $0.13, with Q1 FY26 guidance of $290-298M revenue.

headline: Valmont Reports Fourth Quarter and Full-Year 2024 Results
rationale: Q4 2024 GAAP diluted EPS rose to $3.84 from $1.38 (adjusted diluted EPS $3.84 vs $3.18) on 2.1% sales growth, with record full-year GAAP diluted EPS of $17.19 and 2025 diluted EPS guidance of $17.20-$18.80.

headline: Wingstop Inc. Reports Fiscal Second Quarter 2024 Financial Results
rationale: Q2 2024 GAAP net income rose 69.9% to $27.5M ($0.93 diluted EPS vs $0.54) and adjusted EBITDA (non-GAAP) rose 50.7% on 28.7% domestic same-store sales growth, and the company raised its fiscal 2024 same-store sales outlook to about 20% and net new units to 285-300.

headline: Worthington Steel Reports Second Quarter Fiscal 2026 Results
rationale: Fiscal Q2 2026 net sales rose 18% to $871.9M, GAAP net earnings rose 47% to $18.8M ($0.37 vs $0.25 diluted EPS) and adjusted diluted EPS (non-GAAP) rose to $0.38 from $0.19.

headline: Worthington Steel to Acquire Kloeckner & Co
rationale: Transformative all-cash growth acquisition of Kloeckner & Co at EUR 11 per share (EUR 2.4B enterprise value) creating a ~$9.5B-revenue service center with ~$150M targeted synergies and expected substantial EPS accretion, though pro forma net leverage rises to ~4.0x.

headline: Watts Water Technologies Reports Record First Quarter 2026 Results
rationale: Record Q1 2026 with net sales up 21% (12% organic) to $677.3M, GAAP net income up 34.6% to $99.6M (diluted EPS $2.97 vs $2.21) and adjusted diluted EPS (non-GAAP) up 28% to $3.04, with full-year outlook maintained.

headline: Zions Bancorporation, N.A. reports 1Q26 Net Earnings of $232 million, diluted EPS of $1.56
rationale: Q1 2026 GAAP net earnings to common rose to $232M from $169M and GAAP diluted EPS rose 38% to $1.56, with adjusted pre-provision net revenue (non-GAAP) up 13% and net loan losses of 0.03% annualized.

headline: Zions Bancorporation's Board Announces Approval of Share Repurchase and Declares Dividends on Common and Preferred Stock
rationale: Routine capital return: authorization of up to $225M of buybacks for the rest of 2026 (a $300M full-year target) plus a regular $0.45 quarterly common dividend.
